reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: clause 12.3 expressly disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, or minimum-volume commitment by Customer, and clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach.
The only exclusivity-type restraint (12.4) runs against Vendor in Customer's favour, which the detection guidance treats as acceptable and not a deviation.

No redline or comment is expected or present for a compliant finding; the redline is byte-identical to the originals and the deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains.
Rationale correctly notes remaining 'exclusive' references (jurisdiction, remedies) are not dealing restrictions, so the preferred position is met.
